workflow.replacementRule: All placeholder logical IDs remain stable when final MV-cover/Trinity-inspired original Plushbound artwork replaces them.

visualIdentity.summary: A mistbound wetland of dark mirror-water, reed villages, lantern causeways, peat islands, ancient stitched bog shrines and half-submerged ruins. The region should feel mysterious and beautiful rather than uniformly sinister.
visualIdentity.fashion: Plushtopia Chinese/Japanese/Victorian blend adapted for rain, marsh travel, fishing, herbalism and formal lantern ceremonies.
visualIdentity.finalArtTarget: original Plushbound JRPG artwork with RPG Maker MV/Trinity-inspired functional readability; no copied proprietary artwork

population.canonOcRule: Named canon OCs remain unique identities and are never generated from ambient NPC recipes.

guardians.presentationRule: Guardians are living companions and inhabitants, visually and mechanically distinct from hostile monsters.
guardians.materialEthic: Guardian-associated crafting materials come from bonding, caretaking, gifts, shed materials and environmental collection, never killing Guardians.

qualityGates: All map assets compose on the 48px engine grid where applicable.
Children use age-appropriate proportions, clothing and roles.
Guardian silhouettes remain readable at selection-screen size.
Guardians and hostile monsters cannot be confused visually.
Fog and darkness never make critical traversal or combat telegraphs unreadable.
Flooded and low-water map states preserve clear collision and interaction intent.
Regional fashion remains original Plushbound work and does not copy external IP.
The 2x reserve is meaningful modular variety rather than blind duplicate recolors.
Placeholder assets must never be represented as final production artwork.
completionDefinition: This specification reserves the complete Gloamfen regional placeholder/content asset target for the finished-game build. Binary final artwork remains deferred until the finished-game ZIP milestone, after which placeholders are reworked into the selected MV-cover/Trinity-inspired original Plushbound art style while retaining stable logical IDs.
